# Law page extracts for the parser tests

Small pieces cut from the real pages in `data/laws/raw` (downloaded 10 November
2026), with their markup unchanged:

- `official_journal.html`: GPSR Articles 16, 17 and 19 and its correlation
  table; Regulation (EU) 2019/2015 Article 4 and Annex VIII. The Official
  Journal layout.
- `consolidated.html`: Directive 98/6/EC Article 6a with the marker in front of
  it; UCPD Article 6 and Annex I. The layout of consolidated versions.
- `guidance.html`: the Commission notice on Article 6a: its title, the first
  two paragraphs of the introduction, section 4.3 and the first two footnotes.
- `judgment.html`: Case C-330/23: the titles, paragraphs 1, 3 and 29, the
  ruling, the signatures and the footnote.
- `pangv.xml`: the PAngV: the head of the law and §§ 4 and 11.

EU law texts can be reused freely (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU), and German
laws are not protected by copyright (§ 5 UrhG).
